method: Per context, the measured field strings of the 13 cases are hashed in Figma (FNV-1a of the sorted key=fields lines) and compared with the same strings built from computed.json; an equal hash proves each field equal, so observed repeats expected in its Figma form. The parent text of the code is represented by the Size (md) and Color variants in Figma.
